classification: Final bounded visible real-media Output tail comparison: 3 fresh-process cold + 3 same-process primed warm before, and same after; trace diagnostics kept separate

method.coldDefinition: Fresh Electron process, isolated unique profile and newly loaded Output document; OS/font/disk cache is not globally cleared.
method.warmDefinition: Same Electron/Output document first plays the identical source until 1.2s to prime fonts and line-fit, then pauses/seeks0 and clears only observation arrays before the original full playback protocol. Offset content change can legitimately remeasure.
method.units: milliseconds; positive late, negative early; media and rate-adjusted wall time kept separate
method.firstActivationRule: Mark seen by phase + known chunk startMs from every raw sample, including transitions inside 350ms control exclusion; only then apply identical steady filter. Replay after seek has distinct phase. Prior active carry-over at phase start also marks seen.

traceDiagnostic.limits: Single cold/warm diagnostics with Chromium instrumentation, not pooled with untraced runs. After warm recording covers formal offset fit, not warmup; before warm lacks exact navigation anchor.

limitations: Only synthetic known onsets in actual native-media/local-owner/publisher/Hub/server/Focus Output chain; not model timing, speaker latency, OBS or all-template acceptance.
Fresh-process cold does not flush machine OS/font/disk caches. Warm priming is explicitly within the same Electron and Output document.
Trace and CDP overhead are excluded from the 12 untraced performance cases. Chrome nested style/layout durations are not summed.
Wall/performance epoch calibration is recorded; sub-ms transport order and control discontinuity pairs are not exact latency proof.
Legacy all-transition maxima are preserved; earlier-glyph reentry is separately classified after marking seen from all transitions including control exclusions.
